newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list options on Sabre Group.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list options on Sabre Group.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Monday it would list options on Sabre Group Holdings Inc on Oct 25.
The exchange said the options will have opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with initial expirations in November, December, February and May.
The stock was down 3/4 at 30-1/8 Monday afternoon.
Susquehanna Investment Group will be the specialist unit, the exchange said.
